meta.name: macos-spm-app-packaging
meta.description: Scaffold, build, and package SwiftPM-based macOS apps without an Xcode project. Use when you need a from-scratch macOS app layout, SwiftPM targets/resources, a custom .app bundle assembly script, or signing/notarization/appcast steps outside Xcode.

copy.tagline: 构建并打包 macOS 应用，无需 Xcode 项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在无 Xcode 环境下创建和分发 macOS 应用
copy.tagline_en: Build and package macOS apps without an Xcode project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create and distribute macOS apps outside Xcode

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你创建、构建和打包基于 SwiftPM 的 macOS 应用，无需 Xcode 项目。它会生成项目骨架、编译代码、组装 .app 包，并支持签名、公证和生成更新用的 appcast。
howto.when: 当你需要从头创建一个 macOS 应用，或者想在不打开 Xcode 的情况下完成构建、打包、签名、公证等步骤时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新的 macOS 应用项目，名字叫 HelloApp。
say.note: Claude 会复制模板并重命名文件。
Claude 会执行编译和启动脚本。

say.text: 帮我打包并签名这个应用。
say.note: Claude 会运行打包和签名脚本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can scaffold, build, and package SwiftPM-based macOS apps without Xcode. It generates the project skeleton, compiles code, assembles the .app bundle, and supports signing, notarization, and appcast generation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create a macOS app from scratch, or perform build, package, signing, notarization steps outside Xcode.

say_en.text: Create a new macOS app project named HelloApp.
say_en.note: Claude copies the template and renames files.

say_en.text: Build and run the current project.
say_en.note: Claude runs compile and launch scripts.
Claude runs packaging and signing scripts.
